title: WoDX Interactables
description: World of Darkness Expanded: doors, locks, windows and walls that can be broken through, on core Foundry walls. A player selects a token and presses Interact (token HUD or the I key) to see everything within reach, with the roll, the difficulty, the time and the noise shown before rolling. Results apply at once with an Undo for the Storyteller; only a wall knocked through waits in the approval queue. NPCs in earshot hear loud attempts. Each state can have its own tile picture (or a marker), with a sound and a floating word for every player who can see or hear it; every change is passed on as a map event for NPCs and the Storyteller. The Storyteller can fill a container from Gear by era and everyday goods by era (food, tools, cloth, coin, papers and the like), by the kind of place (first guessed from where the container sits) and the chronicle's era, and checks the draw before it goes in. A map made by a WoDX map generator can be adopted from its WoDX file: doors, shutters, containers, hiding places, lights, climbs and NPC places are set up in one step, with an Undo; a generated village or town's households are kept on their buildings, and the turned buildings and winding streets of an organic town keep their shapes. Private use only; not for distribution or sale. Breaking into a haven (WoDX Storyteller's record) is harder by its security for anyone who does not live there.
